pages.text: $(#df4545)【Ruin】$()$(br2)Explodes on death, dealing 50% of its max health to everything within 4 blocks.$(br)Only a boss's blast breaks blocks; anything else's only hurts.$(br2)$(l)Accessory$(): Hourglass of Ruin, which wards this affix off.
$(l)Dropped material$()$(br2)$(o)Unstable golden grains that slowly break down whatever they touch.$()
